top_signals.title: Japan’s GPIF Boosts JGB Expertise by Employing Active Bond Funds
top_signals.summary: Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund hired active domestic bond funds for the first time in five years, a recognition that one of the world’s biggest retirement money managers needs to increase its expertise to deal with volatility in the nation’s debt market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Korean Stocks Tumble a Second Day, Sparking Trading Suspension
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s stock selloff deepened as chip-makers extended losses following disappointment about SK Hynix Inc.’s earnings and as retail investors cut holdings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
